title: prunus pumila var. typica
intro: Prunus pumila var. typica, commonly known as the American dwarf cherry or sand cherry, is a deciduous shrub native to eastern North America. This plant is valued for its edible fruits, which are rich in antioxidants and have been traditionally used to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of fever and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Prunus pumila var. typica include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to promote overall well-being.
